item.title: Three Distinct Cycling Logo Options

turns.text: Give me three different logo options for my cycling club, Moss & Mile. Simple green and black on white, each with the name and a small symbol. Your call on the symbols, but make them genuinely different ideas. Three separate square images please, not a collage.

item.tests: Produces exactly three separately usable logo variations with distinct concepts and consistent required wording.

answer_sheet.Exact wording: Moss & Mile on every option, including the ampersand; no extra text.
answer_sheet.Number and delivery: Three separate square images, not one collage or contact sheet.
answer_sheet.Style and palette: Simple cycling-club logos using green and black on white.
answer_sheet.How different the options should be: Three genuinely different symbol or layout concepts, not just recolors of one design.

must_haves: Exactly three separate square logo images are delivered.
Each logo clearly reads 'Moss & Mile', including the ampersand.
Each option includes a small symbol alongside or above the name.
The three options have visibly different symbol or layout concepts, rather than only color changes.
All three use green and black on plain white backgrounds without mockup scenes or option labels.

turns.text: Give me three different logo options for my cycling club, Moss & Mile. Simple green and black on white, each with the name and a small symbol. Your call on the symbols, but make them genuinely different ideas. Three separate square images please, not a collage. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
I won’t run anything until you approve the cost.

**Lowest-cost option: 15 credits total** — three separate square images using the free-plan **Flux Schnell** model at **640 × 640**, at 5 credits per image. No upscaling or extra variations.

Each would use green and black on white, with **“Moss & Mile”** and a genuinely different small symbol:
1. **Fern frond** — nature-led, paired with clean lettering.
2. **Winding road** — a simple curved line suggesting distance and exploration.
3. **Bicycle chain link** — a compact geometric symbol for cycling and community.

**Cheaper way:** make just one option first for **5 credits**, then decide whether to spend the remaining 10. Producing all three separately still starts at 15 credits; 640px is the smallest listed size, and “shorter” doesn’t apply to still images.

These would be raster logo concepts, not editable vector files. AI lettering may need cleanup; I won’t automatically spend credits on retries.

**Would you like all three for 15 credits, or one first for 5?**
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that — all three separate images for 15 credits.

dialog.agent:
Magic Hour refused the first request because your account has **insufficient credits**. No images were created, and I haven’t attempted the other two.

The three-image option needs **15 credits**. If you have at least **5 credits**, we could try just one instead—but I won’t make another attempt without your approval.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that — try just one for 5 credits.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour also refused the **5-credit single-image request** due to insufficient credits. No image was created.

You’ll need at least **5 available credits** to generate one logo. I won’t attempt any more generations unless you ask.
